maddeler.e:
اقتتلا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَتَلَا (iqtatalā) /iq.ta.ta.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اِقْتَتِلَا (iqtatilā) /iq.ta.ti.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# اُقْتُتِلَا (uqtutilā) /uq.tu.ti.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
